Day 4 of #100DaysOfCode 🚀

Biggest mistake I made when starting DSA:
Memorizing solutions instead of patterns.

✅ 2 problems solved deeply > 10 copied
✅ Pen & paper dry-run first
✅ Review yesterday's logic

Consistency over intensity. Always 💪

#DSA #Cpp #CodingJourney

🔥 What happened in AI today:

✅ Claude Duet: Proactive real-time AI collaboration
✅ Small models: 10-year CNN beats frontier LLMs
⚡ Shift from chatbots to autonomous terminal agents

Which update surprised you most? 👇

#AI #Tech

Stage par trophy lene ka dream to sabka hota hai 🏆

Reality:
• Hackathons: "Bhai tu CP wala hai, UI kon banayega?"
• CP contests: 4th year seniors abhi bhi participate karke prize le jate hain 😭

Dukh dard peeda. Kahan jayein? 👇

#BTech #Hackathon #CP #CodingLife

The reality of AI coding nobody talks about:

5 mins: "Generate this backend" 🤖
4 hours: Debugging a hallucinated variable that doesn't exist 💀

The real dev skill in 2026 isn't prompt engineering.

It's reading & debugging code you didn't write.

#Coding #WebDev #AI
